CustomField.description: JSON array mapping URL parameter keys to Form Submission fields. Each entry specifies a URL param (e.g., pv1, utm_source) and the Form_Submission__c field to populate. Only applied to new submissions when the form loads outside of Flow context.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Configure via the "URL Parameter Mapping" quick action. Maps URL parameters (pv1-pv9, utm_source, etc.) to Form Submission fields so values are automatically captured when users arrive via a link.
CustomField.label: URL Parameter Mapping
